snippet.title: Lillith Hall Intro Movie
snippet.description:
This is the intro movie for the visual novel Lillith hall, coming soon to itch.io:
https://harlevin.itch.io/lilith-hall

Yuri
40,000 words
A dark story in an immersive world
1 romance route
A large amount of choices that shape 080's future and personality
5 different endings
All original UI 
Animated side sprites
